jobs.occupation: Purchaser to be stationed in Helsingör
jobs.description:
* A structured person, with experience and background from purchasing, sourcing and/or negotiations
* Fluent in English and the Nordic languages (written and spoken).
* Knowledge and experience about the Nordic FMCG market
* Experience with implementing Lean principles in SPL organisations is an big advantage.
* Knowledge of Axapta/other procurement tools and Office programs is an big advantage
 
Good communication & analytical skills, a global mind set and a desire to grow with the team will be emphasized. It is also important for us that our new purchaser can take responsibility and ability and have the ability to work structured and understand the value of team work. As our business is growing we are now seeking an additional Purchaser. Our core values is simplicity, honestly, probity and flexibility. To succeed in the position we expect that our core values characterize your way of working.

* Sourcing, purchasing & negotiation – qualification of existing and/or new suppliers and products, quotations, price development reporting, claims handling,       business terms and conditions negotiation.
* Purchase Order Management - Order follow-up
* Supplier-, product-, claim-, and price data analyses
* Work for increased profitability in our vendor portfolio and reduce procurement costs
* Analyses, registration and follow up of price and product quotations etc.
* Maintain and develop good and effective supplier relations
* Participant and central in projects related to order follow-up managements and procurement systems
* Visit the key suppliers and perform quality controls. Travels are included in the job
* Assisting the General Manager to ensure strategic procurement
* Ensure that purchases are in accordance with laws, regulations and group policy Birgma European Service Company Aps is a part of an international purchasing organization. 
The office is situated in the center of Helsingör.

Education/training
Our roles requires a basic technical education, sometimes university level.

Experience 
We require at least 3 years of relevant job experience for all roles, mostly more. 

Required experience for this role:
- Experience as fullstack web developer  
- Experience with PHP programming
- Experience using Laravel
- Experience with REST APIs
- Experience with version control tools

Working language: English/Danish

Wanted competence
- Experience with Javascript, vue.js
